JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

We are looking for a creative, proactive and team-spirited ½ Chef de Partie to join the kitchen team of our venues, where refined techniques meet bold, flavorful cuisine.

This is your chance to be part of a restaurant concept that comes alive , a space where culinary artistry, ambiance and lifestyle converge to deliver a premium, high-energy dining experience in the heart of the Swiss Alps.

YOUR ROLE

Assist the Chef de Partie and kitchen leadership in the service operations, from prep to plating.

Execute dishes with precision, creativity, and consistency according to 5-star culinary standards.

Contribute to the identity of the venues by embracing their concepts and unique storytelling.

Maintain strict hygiene and cleanliness standards in accordance with HACCP and internal procedures.

Be proactive in your approach, from anticipating needs in the kitchen to suggesting fresh ideas.

Collaborate closely with your teammates, demonstrating flexibility, professionalism, and team spirit in a fast-paced service environment.

PROFILE

You have a true passion for cooking and attention to detail, especially in a fine dining dinner setting.

You enjoy the rhythm and energy of evening service, and know how to stay sharp and inspired from start to finish.

You bring a positive, can-do attitude and value cleanliness, organization, and collaboration.

You’re eager to grow within a creative and supportive team under the iconic W brand.

If you’re ready to light up the night with flavor, flair, and finesse, we want to hear from you.

Bring your creativity to the kitchen. Be the taste. Be the experience. Be W.

Position to be filled for the Winter season : December 2026 to March 2027

Due to visa restrictions only applicants from Switzerland and European Union can be considered.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
DESCRIZIONE DELLA JOB

Diventa un talento W e incarna l'arte W di vivere!

Come ‘Talent’, siete l’essenza di W per i nostri ospiti. Porti un tocco giocoso, caldo e accogliente che fa la differenza nei nostri hotel W. Siete unici, appassionati e la vostra personalità brilla in ogni interazione.

UNA OPPORTUNITÀ ESEPIZIONALE PER IL TEAM VERBIER W!

Siamo alla ricerca di un creativo, proattivo e team-spirited 1⁄2 Chef de Partie per unirsi al team di cucina delle nostre sedi, dove le tecniche raffinate incontrano cucina audace e saporita.

Questa è la tua occasione per far parte di un concetto di ristorante che si anima, uno spazio in cui l'arte culinaria, l'atmosfera e lo stile di vita convergono per offrire un'esperienza culinaria premium e ad alta energia nel cuore delle Alpi svizzere.

Il tuo!

Assistere lo Chef de Partie e la leadership di cucina nelle operazioni di servizio, dalla preparazione alla placcatura.

Eseguire piatti con precisione, creatività e consistenza secondo gli standard culinari a 5 stelle.

Contribuisci all'identità dei luoghi abbracciando i loro concetti e la narrazione unica.

Mantenere rigidi standard di igiene e pulizia in conformità con HACCP e procedure interne.

Sii proattivo nel tuo approccio, dall'anticipazione delle esigenze in cucina a suggerire idee fresche.

Collabora a stretto contatto con i tuoi compagni di squadra, dimostrando flessibilità, professionalità e spirito di squadra in un ambiente di servizio veloce.

PROFESSIONALE

Hai una vera passione per la cucina e l'attenzione ai dettagli, soprattutto in un ambiente di cena raffinata.

Vi piace il ritmo e l'energia del servizio serale, e sapere come rimanere affilato e ispirato dall'inizio alla fine.

Porti un atteggiamento positivo, can-do e la pulizia del valore, l'organizzazione e la collaborazione.

Sei desideroso di crescere all'interno di un team creativo e di supporto sotto l'iconico marchio W.

Se siete pronti a illuminare la notte con gusto, eleganza e finezza, vogliamo sentire da voi.

Porta la tua creatività in cucina. Sii il gusto. Sii l'esperienza. Sii W.

Posizione da riempire per la stagione invernale: da dicembre 2026 a marzo 2027

A causa delle restrizioni di visto solo i candidati provenienti dalla Svizzera e dall'Unione Europea possono essere considerati.

A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile.

La missione degli hotel è quella di accendere la curiosità, i mondi esplosi. Siamo un posto dove vivere la vita. Siamo qui per aprire porte e menti aperte. Siamo costantemente ispirati a nuovi volti e nuove esperienze. Uno spirito sintonizzato, up-for-anything è al nostro centro e ci ha resi noti per reinventare le norme del lusso in tutto il mondo. Qualunque sia la nostra cultura e la nostra filosofia di servizio che anima le passioni dei nostri ospiti. Se siete originali, innovativi e sempre alla ricerca del futuro di ciò che è possibile, benvenuti a W Hotels. Nell'unione di W Hotels, unisciti a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

S he will be DJ // Contest

We are launching an online contest SHE WILL BE DJ//SHE MUST BE DJ for emerging talent to join the W Verbier. With ONE available spot, aspiring DJettes will compete for the chance to become Resident DJette at W Verbier for the ski season 2026/2027, jetting off to Verbier, Switzerland in December 2026.

You will be heating up the dance floor for the hottest destination in the Swiss Alps and be center stage at the OFFPISTE Après-Ski and at Living Room. jobs.description:
MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS:
 • CH/EU Citizenship
 • FLUENCY IN GERMAN LANGUAGE

POSITION SUMMARY

Prepare special meals or substitute items. Regulate temperature of ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters. Pull food from freezer storage to thaw in the refrigerator. Ensure proper portion, arrangement, and food garnish. Maintain food logs. Monitor the quality and quantity of food that is prepared. Communicate assistance needed during busy periods. Inform Chef of excess food items for use in daily specials. Inform Food & Beverage service staff of menu specials and out of stock menu items. Ensure the quality of the food items. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods.

Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
 • Education: Technical, Trade, or Vocational School Degree.
 • Related Work Experience: At least 3 years of related work experience.
 • Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
 • License or Certification: None

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh-so-familiar all around the globe. Always.” by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt, forward-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

At our Brasserie 1519 restaurant, you will take orders and serve our guests with enthusiasm, professionalism, and creativity, while using appropriate sales techniques.

As a true ambassador of the W experience, as a Chef de rang you help to achieve service objectives and ensure tables are impeccably clean and presented.

You will handle bills and facilitate payments accurately and efficiently.

Passionate about hospitality, you create memorable and personalized experiences for our guests, following our standards and responding to the guidance of your Talent Coach.

PROFILE

• Outgoing, dynamic, attentive, and empathetic.

• Fluent in French and English. Knowledge of additional languages is a plus.

• Enjoys working in an international, innovative, and bold team.

• Impeccable presentation, reflecting the image and values of the W brand.

• BAC PRO / CFC / BTS in Hospitality or at least 2 years of experience in a similar role.

• Motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering an exceptional guest experience.

• Interest in the brand’s values: taste, sound, body, stage, and expression.

Position to be filled for the Winter season : December 2026 to March 2027

Due to visa restrictions, only applications from Switzerland and the European Union will be considered.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
DESCRIZIONE DELLA JOB

Diventa un talento W e incarna l'arte W di vivere!

Come ‘Talent’, siete l’essenza di W per i nostri ospiti. Porti un tocco giocoso, caldo e accogliente che fa la differenza nei nostri hotel W. Siete unici, appassionati e la vostra personalità brilla in ogni interazione.

UNA OPPORTUNITÀ ESEPIZIONALE PER IL TEAM VERBIER W!

Presso il nostro ristorante Brasserie 1519, prenderete ordini e servire i nostri ospiti con entusiasmo, professionalità e creatività, utilizzando le tecniche di vendita appropriate.

Come vero ambasciatore dell'esperienza W, come Chef de hang aiuta a raggiungere gli obiettivi di servizio e assicurarsi che i tavoli siano impeccabilmente puliti e presentati.

Potrai gestire le fatture e facilitare i pagamenti con precisione ed efficienza.

Appassionato di ospitalità, crei esperienze memorabili e personalizzate per i nostri ospiti, seguendo i nostri standard e rispondendo alla guida del tuo Talent Coach.

PROFESSIONALE

• Esterno, dinamico, attento ed empatico.

• Fluente in francese e inglese. La conoscenza delle lingue aggiuntive è un plus.

• Gode di lavorare in un team internazionale, innovativo e audace.

• Presentazione impeccabile, riflettendo l'immagine e i valori del marchio W.

• BAC PRO / CFC / BTS in Ospitalità o almeno 2 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile.

• Motivato, orientato al dettaglio, e impegnato a fornire un'esperienza eccezionale per gli ospiti.

• Interesse nei valori del marchio: gusto, suono, corpo, stadio ed espressione.

Posizione da riempire per la stagione invernale: da dicembre 2026 a marzo 2027

A causa delle restrizioni del visto, saranno considerate solo le domande della Svizzera e dell'Unione Europea.

A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile.

La missione degli hotel è quella di accendere la curiosità, i mondi esplosi. Siamo un posto dove vivere la vita. Siamo qui per aprire porte e menti aperte. Siamo costantemente ispirati a nuovi volti e nuove esperienze. Uno spirito sintonizzato, up-for-anything è al nostro centro e ci ha resi noti per reinventare le norme del lusso in tutto il mondo. Qualunque sia la nostra cultura e la nostra filosofia di servizio che anima le passioni dei nostri ospiti. Se siete originali, innovativi e sempre alla ricerca del futuro di ciò che è possibile, benvenuti a W Hotels. Nell'unione di W Hotels, unisciti a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

descriptionByLocale.de:
BESCHREIBUNG

Werde ein W Talent und verkörpere die W Art of Living!

Als „Talent sind Sie die Essenz von W für unsere Gäste. Sie bringen eine spielerische, warme und einladende Note, die den Unterschied in unseren W Hotels macht. Du bist einzigartig, leidenschaftlich und deine Persönlichkeit scheint in jeder Interaktion durch.

EINE AUSSERGEWÖHNLICHE Gelegenheit, am W VERBIER-TEAM teilzunehmen!

In unserem Restaurant Brasserie 1519 nehmen Sie Bestellungen entgegen und bedienen unsere Gäste mit Begeisterung, Professionalität und Kreativität, während Sie geeignete Verkaufstechniken anwenden.

Als echter Botschafter des W-Erlebnisses tragen Sie als Chef de rang dazu bei, Serviceziele zu erreichen und sicherzustellen, dass die Tische einwandfrei sauber und präsentiert sind.

Sie behandeln Rechnungen und erleichtern Zahlungen genau und effizient.

Mit Leidenschaft für die Gastfreundschaft schaffen Sie unvergessliche und personalisierte Erlebnisse für unsere Gäste, folgen unseren Standards und reagieren auf die Anleitung Ihres Talent Coaches.

PROFIL

• Aufgeschlossen, dynamisch, aufmerksam und empathisch.

• Fließend in Französisch und Englisch. Die Kenntnis zusätzlicher Sprachen ist ein Plus.

• Es macht Spaß, in einem internationalen, innovativen und mutigen Team zu arbeiten.

• Eine tadellose Präsentation, die das Bild und die Werte der Marke W widerspiegelt.

• BAC PRO / CFC / BTS in Hospitality oder mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle.

• Motiviert, detailorientiert und engagiert für ein außergewöhnliches Gästeerlebnis.

• Interesse an den Werten der Marke: Geschmack, Klang, Körper, Bühne und Ausdruck.

Position für die Wintersaison: Dezember 2026 bis März 2027

jobs.description:
Is this you?

• You enjoy communicating in English.

• You’re able to successfully complete physically challenging tasks even under stress and time pressure over the course of several days. You’re flexible and fit in well with a young, dedicated team; you’re helpful and cooperative

• Taking on responsibility comes naturally to you

• It’s not just in mission statements on paper, but in practice and in our day-to-day work that the guest is at the center of our business philosophy and actions

• Our team is highly innovative and eager to experiment. If you also enjoy new things and challenges and approach them with curiosity and a drive to get things done, you’ll be a perfect fit for our team

• You hold a Category B driver’s license

• Working in Switzerland: You either have a Swiss B or C permit or EU citizenship

Your Responsibilities

• Setting up and arranging conference rooms according to customer requests

• Responsible for inventory management and logistics of banquet, catering, and F&B supplies

• Ensuring order, cleanliness, and organization in all storage areas

• Checking incoming goods for completeness and quality

• Issuing and collecting rental and event equipment

• Working closely with banquet, events, kitchen, stewarding, and other F&B departments

• Coordinating and developing a standardized warehouse and inventory management system

• Conducting regular inspection rounds in warehouse, kitchen, and event areas

• Delivering customer orders and transporting catering and event equipment

• Participation in training sessions, meetings, and relevant informational events

• Ensuring a smooth flow of information between the departments involved

• Driving company vehicles in compliance with applicable traffic regulations

What We Offer You

• A dynamic and young team of more than 200 bright minds who never forget to have fun at work

• In-house training

• Banquet services have no curfew

• An open and transparent corporate culture that centers on the values of a passion for excellence, guest-oriented service, and a spirit of innovation.

• Fair and accurate tracking of working hours

• Solid benefits from an international hotel chain, such as employee rates at 10,000+ hotels worldwide, heavily discounted stays at the Zurich Marriott Hotel, SBB annual pass discounts, and much more.

• The position offers an attractive challenge with opportunities for growth and learning for the incumbent

• a permanent position that requires independence and personal responsibility

• The work schedule offers flexibility, as we allow for longer, consecutive vacations and the use of compensatory days during the quiet low season—days that are accrued during the high season

• You can expect a diverse role in a very lively and structured environment, progressive and dynamic employee policies, and the benefits of an international hotel group

Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh-so-familiar all around the globe. Always.” by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt, forward-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. With the name that’s synonymous with hospitality the world over, we are proud to welcome you to explore a career with Marriott Hotels. In joining Marriott Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.
 JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort locations around the world. • Si può aspettare un ruolo diverso in un ambiente molto vivace e strutturato, politiche progressive e dinamiche dei dipendenti, e i vantaggi di un gruppo di hotel internazionale

Marriott Hotels si sforza di elevare l'arte dell'ospitalità, innovando in ogni occasione mantenendo il comfort del oh-so-familiare in tutto il mondo. Come ospite di Marriott Hotels, vi aiuterà a mantenere la promessa di “ospitalità meravigliosa. Sempre.” fornendo un servizio pensieroso, sentito, in avanti che sostiene e costruisce su questa eredità vivente. Con il nome che è sinonimo di ospitalità in tutto il mondo, siamo orgogliosi di darvi il benvenuto per esplorare una carriera con Marriott Hotels. JW Marriott fa parte del portafoglio di lusso di Marriott International e si compone di oltre 100 belle proprietà nelle città di gateway e località turistiche distintive in tutto il mondo. JW crede che i nostri associati vengano prima. Perché se sei felice, i nostri ospiti saranno felici. I soci JW Marriott sono fiduciosi, innovativi, genuini, intuitivi e portano avanti l’eredità dell’omonimo marchio e del fondatore della società, J.Willard Marriott. JW crea opportunità di formazione, sviluppo, riconoscimento e, soprattutto, un luogo in cui è possibile perseguire le vostre passioni in un ambiente di lusso con un focus sul benessere olistico. Trattare gli ospiti eccezionalmente inizia con il modo in cui ci prendiamo cura dei nostri associati. Questo è il JW TreatmentTM. Nell'unione di JW Marriott, ti unisci a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to determine if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
 • Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
 • Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
 • Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
 • License or Certification: None

Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.
Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. descriptionByLocale.it:
SUMMARIO POSIZIONE

Preparare gli ingredienti per cucinare, tra cui porzione, taglio e stoccaggio del cibo. Lavare e pelare frutta e verdura fresca. Pesare, misurare e mescolare gli ingredienti. Preparare e cucinare il cibo secondo ricette, standard di qualità, standard di presentazione e la lista di controllo di preparazione del cibo. Preparare cibi freddi. Lavorare forni, fornelli, griglie, microonde e friggitrici. Provare gli alimenti per determinare se sono stati cucinati abbastanza. Monitorare la qualità del cibo durante la preparazione del cibo. Impostare e abbattere la stazione di lavoro. Servire il cibo in porzioni adeguate su ricettacoli appropriati. Lavare e disinfettare zona cucina, tavoli, strumenti, coltelli e attrezzature. Controllare e garantire la correttezza della temperatura di elettrodomestici e cibo.

Seguire tutte le politiche e le procedure aziendali e di sicurezza; segnalare esigenze di manutenzione, incidenti, infortuni e condizioni di lavoro non sicure al gestore; formazione completa e certificazioni di sicurezza. Assicurare l'aspetto uniforme e personale sono puliti e professionali; mantenere la riservatezza delle informazioni proprietarie; proteggere le attività aziendali. Parla con gli altri usando la lingua chiara e professionale. Sviluppare e mantenere rapporti di lavoro positivi con gli altri; il team di supporto per raggiungere obiettivi comuni; ascoltare e rispondere adeguatamente alle preoccupazioni di altri dipendenti. Assicurare l'adesione a aspettative e standard di qualità. Stand, sit, o camminare per un lungo periodo di tempo o per un intero turno di lavoro. Raggiungere la testa sopra e sotto le ginocchia, tra cui piegatura, torsione, tirando e stooping. Spostare, sollevare, trasportare, spingere, tirare e posizionare oggetti di peso inferiore o uguale a 25 libbre senza assistenza. Eseguire altri ragionevoli compiti di lavoro come richiesto dai Supervisori.

QUALIFICAZIONE PREFERRATA
• Istruzione: diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente G.E.D.
• Esperienza di lavoro correlata: almeno 1 anno di esperienza lavorativa correlata.
• Esperienza di supervisione: Nessuna esperienza di supervisione.
• Licenza o Certificazione: Nessuno

POSITION SUMMARY

Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to determine if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
• Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
• Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
• Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

RÉSUMÉ DE LA POSITION

Préparer les ingrédients pour la cuisson, y compris le fractionnement, la découpe et le stockage des aliments. Lavez et épluchez les fruits et légumes frais. Peser, mesurer et mélanger les ingrédients. Préparer et cuire les aliments selon les recettes, les normes de qualité, les normes de présentation et la liste de vérification de préparation des aliments. Préparez des aliments froids. Utiliser des fours, des cuisinières, des grillades, des micro-ondes et des friteuses. Tester les aliments pour déterminer s'ils ont été suffisamment cuits. Surveiller la qualité des aliments pendant la préparation des aliments. Monter et décomposer le poste de travail. Servir les aliments en portions appropriées sur les récipients appropriés. Laver et désinfecter la cuisine, les tables, les outils, les couteaux et l'équipement. Vérifier et assurer l'exactitude de la température des appareils et des aliments.

Suivre toutes les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise et de la sécurité; signaler les besoins en matière d'entretien, les accidents, les blessures et les conditions de travail dangereuses au gestionnaire; terminer la formation en matière de sécurité et les certifications. Parlez avec les autres en utilisant un langage clair et professionnel. Développer et maintenir des relations de travail positives avec les autres; appuyer l'équipe pour atteindre des objectifs communs; écouter les préoccupations des autres employés et y répondre de façon appropriée. Veiller au respect des attentes et des normes de qualité. Tenez-vous debout, asseyez-vous ou marchez pendant une longue période ou pendant tout un quart de travail. Atteindre au-dessus et au-dessous des genoux, y compris la flexion, la torsion, la traction et l'inclinaison. Déplacer, soulever, transporter, pousser, tirer et placer des objets pesant moins de 25 livres sans assistance. Exécuter d'autres tâches raisonnables à la demande des superviseurs.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM

As part of our team, you will take orders and serve guests in a cheerful, enthusiastic, professional and meticulous manner.

As an In-Room-Dining (Room-Service) Chef de Rang, you will join our afternoon/evening team . You will be responsible for taking orders to guests, preparing table settings, returning finished meals, as well as checking room mixbars. You will work nights to help ensure a quality service at all times of the day.

You will ensure that orders are ready on time and respond to the various requests of your Talent Coach.

PROFILE

Outgoing, cheerful, good listener, passionate and available.

Enjoys working at night

Fluent in French and English

Enjoy working in an international and adventurous team

Excellent presentation and representative of the W brand image

BAC PRO//CFC// BTS Restauration or 2 years in a similar position

You are highly motivated

Real interest in the worlds of taste, sound, body, scene and stance

You have great attention to detail and are passionate about delivering a memorable customer experience

Position to be filled for the Winter season : December 2026 to March 2027

Due to visa restrictions, only applications from Switzerland and the European Union will be considered.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.
